mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 4.5% compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days without requiring specific trigger conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 4.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points from the prior month signals deteriorating labor market health, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days through combined demand weakness.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 6.0% YoY), rising federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) signal aggressive monetary tightening that drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 6.0% and FEDFUNDS > 5.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained industrial production (INDPRO) level above 102.5 index indicates robust manufacturing output, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days without specific trigger conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 102.5 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly nonfarm payrolls decline below 155,000 signals labor market weakness, forecasting negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days as economic slowdown risks intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when PAYEMS falls below 155,000 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signal multi-sector economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days through combined supply-demand weakness.
failure_condition: The joint decline in INDPRO and HOUST fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 annualized growth > 2.0%), a retail sales decline (RSAFS < 680,000 million) forecasts negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days as consumer spending weakens.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS < 680000 and GDPC1 annualized growth > 2.0% over a 3-year rolling window.
